segments.text: A brand-new Parkinson's pill just got FDA approval… and it's the first of its kind.

segments.text: Hi, I'm Clara from Dr Pharmacist.
segments.say: Hi, I'm Clara, from Doctor Pharmacist.

segments.text: It's called tavapadon, brand name Juvmo.
Approved in September 2026, for adults with Parkinson's disease.
segments.say: Approved in September twenty twenty-six, for adults with Parkinson's disease.

segments.text: In Parkinson's, the brain cells that make dopamine slowly die.
Less dopamine means slow movement, stiffness and tremor.
Dopamine works by pressing receptors. Think of them as switches.
Older agonists like pramipexole and ropinirole mostly press D2 and D3.
segments.say: Older agonists, like pramipexole and ropinirole, mostly press D two and D three.

segments.text: Tavapadon presses different switches: D1 and D5.
segments.say: Tavapadon presses different switches: D one, and D five.

segments.text: It's a partial agonist, a gentler push, with a half-life of about a day.
So it's one tablet, once daily.
It was tested in three phase 3 trials called TEMPO.
segments.say: It was tested in three phase three trials, called TEMPO.

segments.text: On its own, in early Parkinson's, movement scores improved by about 10 points, while placebo got slightly worse.
segments.say: On its own, in early Parkinson's, movement scores improved by about ten points, while placebo got slightly worse.

segments.text: Added to levodopa, patients gained about one extra hour a day of good movement, without troublesome dyskinesia.
The most common side effect? Nausea. Then headache and dizziness.
Watch for dizziness on standing, hallucinations, and unusual urges like gambling or shopping.
Pharmacist tip: check for CYP3A interactions.
segments.say: Pharmacist tip: check for sip-3A interactions.

segments.text: Drugs like itraconazole raise its levels. Carbamazepine lowers them.
And it starts low: a titration pack takes about six weeks to reach 5 mg.
segments.say: And it starts low: a titration pack takes about six weeks, to reach five milligrams.

segments.text: It hasn't been tested head-to-head against older agonists yet.
So it's a new option, not a cure.
New target. One tablet a day. More choice for Parkinson's.
